expected_level_description: You can: - organise the administrative support for a service or directorate - write and improve administrative procedures - train and check the work of other administrators
You can: - build templates, trackers, and simple automated workflows - make documents accessible to everyone - help colleagues get the most from office tools
You can: - handle routine correspondence and enquiries yourself - draft letters and replies for others to sign - keep correspondence logs and chase replies
You can: - manage diaries for a team, resolving clashes - arrange travel, events, and meetings with outside partners - make sure papers and actions are ready before meetings

You can: - take formal minutes of board and committee meetings, including complex or contentious discussion - keep formal meeting records that stand up to audit and inquiry - advise chairs on what the record should show
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - supervise day-to-day work and give feedback - take part in recruitment and induction - hold regular one-to-one conversations
You can: - follow the rules for spending and ordering - explain how your work is funded
